svg.text: ESP32 antenna up, its pin-32 row on the left. Every dot is a hole, 2.54 mm apart.
insulated wire on top, ESP32 side
insulated wire on top, Game Boy side
3.3 V wire, already through the 330 Ω in the tail
bare wire on the copper side: ground chain
resistor leg bent onto the chip pad
white dot = pin 1 mark on the chip
The two ground chains never touch. Chip #1 is turned around compared to #2, #3 and #4.
30-pin ESP32 boards have pin 13 between 12 and GND: follow the labels printed on your board.
Crossings without a dot are not connected: top wires pass over the copper-side chains.
